resources.string: ZCHAT uses Zcash shielded transactions to send encrypted messages directly on the blockchain. Your messages are encrypted with keys that only you and your recipient know — not us, not anyone else.
Unable to find a web browser app.
We don\'t have servers. Your messages live on the Zcash blockchain — decentralized and censorship-resistant. We literally cannot read your messages or collect your data.
No phone number. No email. No account. Just download and start chatting. Your identity is your Zcash address — nothing more.
Every message is encrypted using zero-knowledge cryptography. Even the Zcash network validators cannot see your message contents.
No AI. No Clouds. No Tracking.
We don\'t use AI to analyze your messages. We don\'t store anything in the cloud. We don\'t track you. There\'s nothing to leak because we collect nothing.
Built on the battle-tested Zcash protocol. Don\'t trust us — verify the code yourself.
ZCHAT: The messenger that knows nothing about you.
